verdict.rationale: Audience export is a fair question for an email marketing platform, so the axis applies. Nothing in the pack documents self-serve export of contacts, custom fields, tags, engagement history or suppression lists in an open format. The line "all your data stay intact" is about data retention after the trial ends, not about exporting it.

support.subject: As a founder, I can export my entire audience — contacts, custom fields, tags, engagement history, and suppression list — in an open format, self-serve
